name: Bounded 3D Distance Texture Ray Marching
aliases: 3D Texture Distance Function with Boundary Shell
Distance function for a cube sized 3D texture
definition: A ray marching technique that uses a 3D distance texture to represent an implicit surface, employing two bounding boxes (red and green) to handle boundary conditions and invalid distance values at texture edges.
summary: Bounded 3D Distance Texture Ray Marching evaluates signed distance functions using 3D textures while preventing sampling artifacts at edges by returning boundary distances for invalid regions.
